identificationModule.briefTitle: A Clinical Study of IBI130 for Subjects With Unresectable, Locally Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 1/2, Multicenter, Open-label Study of IBI130 in Subjects With Unresectable, Locally Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a phase 1/2 multicenter, open-label, first-in-human study of IBI130. It includes a phase 1 dose escalation and expansion section to identify MTD/RP2D of IBI130, plan to enroll 20\~182 subjects,and a phase 2 to explore efficacy, safety and tolerability of IBI130 at RP2D in specified types of solid tumor.Approximately 150 evaluable subjects will be enrolled for phase 2.

interventions.name: IBI130
interventions.description: Subjects will receive IBI130 until unacceptable toxicity, disease progression, withdrawal of consent, occurrence of other reasons for discontinuing study therapy, or for a maximum of 24 months of treatment, whichever occurs first.

primaryOutcomes.description: Adverse events will be assessed by investigator(s) according to NCI-CTCAE v5.0
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 30 days post last dose

secondaryOutcomes.description: ORR is the percentage of complete response(CR) plus partial response assessed(PR) per RECIST v1.1 criteria
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Time from first dose to best response to treatment, assessed up to 3 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: For subjects with CR or PR,duration of response(DoR) is the time from the first documented CR or PR to disease progression assessed per RESICT v1.1 criteria or death
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Duration of response from the first documentation of objective response (confirmed CR or PR) to the first documented disease progression, assessed up to 3 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: Time from the date of the first dose to death of the subject due to any cause
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Time from first dose to death, assessed up to 3 years
